A relation \(R\) is defined in the set \(N\) as follows :
\(R = \{(x, y) : y = x + 5, y > 5\}\)
Then which of the following is correct ?

hi.stem:
समुच्चय \(N\) में संबंध \(R\) निम्नवत् परिभाषित है
\(R = \{(x, y) : y = x + 5, y > 5\}\)
तब निम्नलिखित में से कौन सही है ?

questions.stem: The value of \(\int_{0}^{\pi/4} \sin^3 2x \cos 2x \, dx\) is

hi.stem: \(\int_{0}^{\pi/4} \sin^3 2x \cos 2x \, dx\) का मान है

questions._flag: English option D is faint and reads like 1/10; the Hindi prints a clear 1/16, used for both.

questions.stem: The probability of impossible events is

hi.stem: असंभव घटनाओं की प्रायिकता होती है

questions._flag: Closest subtopic only: tests the basic fact P(impossible event) = 0, which no Class 12 subtopic covers.

questions.stem: Find the value of \(\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + 2\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\).

hi.stem: \(\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + 2\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Write \(\cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}\right), x > 1\) in the simplified form.

hi.stem: \(\cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}\right), x > 1\) को सरलतम रूप में लिखिए।

questions.stem: If the direction ratios of a line are \(3, -2, -6\), then find its direction cosines.

hi.stem: यदि किसी रेखा के दिक्-अनुपात \(3, -2, -6\), तो इनकी दिक्-कोज्यायें ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Find the angle between the vectors \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\).

hi.stem: सदिशों \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\) और \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\) के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Show that the given function \(f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + 12x\), \(x \in R\) is increasing function on \(R\).

hi.stem: दिखाइए कि प्रदत्त फलन \(f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + 12x\), \(x \in R\), \(R\) पर वर्धमान फलन है।

questions.stem: If \(\vec{a} = 5\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 3\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\) are two vectors, then show that \((\vec{a} + \vec{b})\) and \((\vec{a} - \vec{b})\) are perpendicular.

hi.stem: यदि दो सदिश \(\vec{a} = 5\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 3\hat{k}\) एवं \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\) हैं, तो दिखाइए कि \((\vec{a} + \vec{b})\) एवं \((\vec{a} - \vec{b})\) लम्बवत् हैं।

questions._flag: A serial stamp crosses the Hindi word एवं before b; it is legible enough and matches the English.

questions.stem:
If \(A\) and \(B\) are independent events and \(P(A) = 0.3\) and \(P(B) = 0.4\), then find
(i) \(P(A \cap B)\),
(ii) \(P(A \cup B)\).

hi.stem:
यदि \(A\) और \(B\) स्वतन्त्र घटनाएँ हैं तथा \(P(A) = 0.3\) एवं \(P(B) = 0.4\), तब
(i) \(P(A \cap B)\),
(ii) \(P(A \cup B)\) ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Prove that the relation given by \(R = \{(1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (1, 2), (2, 3)\}\) in a set \(\{1, 2, 3\}\) is reflexive but not symmetric and not transitive.
If \(\sin^{-1}(1 - x) - 2\sin^{-1} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), then find the value of \(x\).
If \((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} - \vec{b}) = 8\) and \(|\vec{a}| = 8|\vec{b}|\) then find \(|\vec{a}|\) and \(|\vec{b}|\).

hi.stem: यदि \((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} - \vec{b}) = 8\) और \(|\vec{a}| = 8|\vec{b}|\) हों तो \(|\vec{a}|\) एवं \(|\vec{b}|\) ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Simplify : \(\cos\theta \begin{bmatrix} \cos\theta & \sin\theta \\ -\sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{bmatrix} + \sin\theta \begin{bmatrix} \sin\theta & -\cos\theta \\ \cos\theta & \sin\theta \end{bmatrix}\).

hi.stem: \(\cos\theta \begin{bmatrix} \cos\theta & \sin\theta \\ -\sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{bmatrix} + \sin\theta \begin{bmatrix} \sin\theta & -\cos\theta \\ \cos\theta & \sin\theta \end{bmatrix}\) को सरल कीजिए।

questions.stem: Simplify : \(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3a^2x - x^3}{a^3 - 3ax^2}\right)\).

hi.stem: \(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3a^2x - x^3}{a^3 - 3ax^2}\right)\) को सरल कीजिए।

questions.stem: Show that the points \(A(2, 3, -4)\), \(B(1, -2, 3)\) and \(C(3, 8, -11)\) are collinear.

questions.subtopic: Graphical Solution and the Feasible Region
questions.stem: Find the minimum value of the objective function \(Z = 3x + 5y\) under the following constraints \(x + 3y \geq 3\), \(x + y \geq 2\), \(x \geq 0\), \(y \geq 0\) by graphical method.

hi.stem:
आलेखीय विधि द्वारा उद्देश्य फलन \(Z = 3x + 5y\) का न्यूनतम मान निम्नलिखित अवरोधों के अंतर्गत ज्ञात कीजिए :
\(x + 3y \geq 3\), \(x + y \geq 2\), \(x \geq 0\), \(y \geq 0\)

questions.stem: Find the minimum distance between the lines \(\vec{r} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \lambda(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k})\) and \(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\).

hi.stem: रेखाओं \(\vec{r} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \lambda(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k})\) और \(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\) के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions._flag: The two prints genuinely differ (checked at full size by the main session: the English + before mu shows its vertical stroke, so the English minus signs are real). English: 2i - j - k + mu(3i - 5j - 2k); Hindi (= NCERT Ex 11.2 Q15): 2i + j - k + mu(3i - 5j + 2k). Solve the English as printed and give the Hindi version too, with a Note in both languages.

questions.stem: If \(y = Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx}\), then show that \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny = 0\).

hi.stem: यदि \(y = Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx}\) है, तो दिखाइए कि \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny = 0\).

questions._flag: The English exponents mx and nx are faint; the Hindi prints them clearly.

questions.stem:
Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\) for which the function defined by
\(f(x) = \begin{cases} ax + 1, & \text{if } x \leq 3 \\ bx + 3, & \text{if } x > 3 \end{cases}\)
is continuous at \(x = 3\).

hi.stem:
\(a\) और \(b\) के उन मानों को ज्ञात कीजिए, जिसके लिए फलन
\(f(x) = \begin{cases} ax + 1, & \text{यदि } x \leq 3 \\ bx + 3, & \text{यदि } x > 3 \end{cases}\)
द्वारा परिभाषित है तथा \(x = 3\) पर संतत है।

questions.stem: Find the value of the determinant \(\begin{vmatrix} 18 & 22 & -13 \\ 7 & -9 & 11 \\ -11 & 7 & 17 \end{vmatrix}\).

hi.stem: सारणिक \(\begin{vmatrix} 18 & 22 & -13 \\ 7 & -9 & 11 \\ -11 & 7 & 17 \end{vmatrix}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Three vectors \(\vec{a}\), \(\vec{b}\) and \(\vec{c}\) satisfy the condition \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = 0\). If \(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\) and \(|\vec{c}| = 2\), then find the value of \(\mu = \vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}\).

hi.stem: तीन सदिश \(\vec{a}\), \(\vec{b}\) एवं \(\vec{c}\) प्रतिबन्ध \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = 0\) को संतुष्ट करते हैं। यदि \(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\) और \(|\vec{c}| = 2\) तो \(\mu = \vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Prove that the height of a cylinder of maximum volume, inscribed in the sphere of radius \(R\) is \(\frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\).

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि एक \(R\) त्रिज्या के गोले के अंतर्गत अधिकतम आयतन के बेलन की ऊँचाई \(\frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) है।

questions.stem: Differentiate : \(y = x^{\sin x} + (\cos x)^{\tan x}\).

hi.stem: अवकलन कीजिए : \(y = x^{\sin x} + (\cos x)^{\tan x}\).

questions.stem: Prove that if \(E\) and \(F\) are two independent events, then \(E\) and \(F'\) will also be independent.

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि यदि \(E\) और \(F\) दो स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं, तो \(E\) और \(F'\) भी स्वतंत्र होंगी।

questions.stem: Find the area, surrounded by line \(y = 3x + 2\), \(x\)-axis and abscissas \(x = -1\) and \(x = 1\).

hi.stem: रेखा \(y = 3x + 2\), \(x\)-अक्ष एवं भुजों \(x = -1\) एवं \(x = 1\) से घिरा क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions._flag: In the English, x = -1 is faint at the page edge; the Hindi prints it clearly.

questions.stem:
Solve the following system of equations :
\(3x - 2y + 3z = 8\)
\(2x + y - z = 1\)
\(4x - 3y + 2z = 4\)
by matrix method.

hi.stem:
निम्नलिखित समीकरण निकाय
\(3x - 2y + 3z = 8\)
\(2x + y - z = 1\)
\(4x - 3y + 2z = 4\)
को आव्यूह विधि से हल कीजिए।

questions.stem: Express the matrix \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -2 & -4 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\) in the form of the sum of symmetric matrix and skew-symmetric matrix.

hi.stem: आव्यूह \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -2 & -4 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\) को एक सममित आव्यूह तथा एक विषम सममित आव्यूह के योगफल के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।

questions.stem: Solve the differential equation \((x\,dy - y\,dx)\,y \sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = (y\,dx + x\,dy)\,x \cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\).

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \((x\,dy - y\,dx)\,y \sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = (y\,dx + x\,dy)\,x \cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\) को हल कीजिए।

questions.stem:
Find the value of
\(\int_{-1}^{2} |x^3 - x| \, dx\)

Find the value of
\(\int_{1}^{4} (|x - 1| + |x - 2| + |x - 3|) \, dx\)
Find the value of integration \(\int \frac{x^4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)} \, dx\).

hi.stem: समाकल \(\int \frac{x^4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)} \, dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions._flag: A serial stamp crosses the English denominator so its first factor reads like (x + 1); the clean Hindi prints (x - 1), used for both.

questions.stem: Show that the general solution of the differential equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{y^2 + y + 1}{x^2 + x + 1} = 0\) is \(x + y + 1 = A(1 - x - y - 2xy)\), in which \(A\) is a parameter.

hi.stem: दर्शाइए कि अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{y^2 + y + 1}{x^2 + x + 1} = 0\) का व्यापक हल \(x + y + 1 = A(1 - x - y - 2xy)\) है, जिसमें \(A\) एक प्राचल है।
